notesStmt.note: Whitman's note at the top of the manuscript indicates that he wrote this draft sometime before March 3, 1888. Given the fact that he was under contract to deliver ten poems to the Herald each month (see ), these poems were typically written and revised over a short period of time. It is most likely, therefore, that the present manuscript dates to between February and March of 1888.

note.p: "Broadway" appeared in the 10 April 1888 issue of the New York Herald, and it was republished in November Boughs (1888) and subsequent printings of Leaves of Grass.
